title: The Machine of Station Meridian Revisited
author: Zephyrine Dunmore
blurb: Juniper Winterbourne, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
